# Question 1
## Part a

In order to know what statistical test is the most appropriate for our data, we need to summarize our data first. 


 \normalsize


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
overhear = c(1.0000, 1.0000, 0.7500, 1.0000, 0.4167, 0.8333, 0.7500, 0.8333, 0.8333, 1.0000)

summary_overhear = data.frame(
  Statistics = c("Mean", "SD", "Median", "IQR", "Skewness", "Excess_Kurtosis", "Min", "Max"),
  Value      = c(mean(overhear), sd(overhear), median(overhear), IQR(overhear),
                 e1071::skewness(overhear), e1071::kurtosis(overhear), min(overhear), max(overhear))
)
```
:::


 \normalsize


 \normalsize


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pdiff = c(-0.0833, 0.0000, -0.0833, -0.0833, 0.5833, 0.0833, -0.2500, 0.1667, 0.0000, -0.4167)

summary_pdiff = data.frame(
  Statistics = c("Mean", "SD", "Median", "IQR", "Skewness", "Excess_Kurtosis", "Min", "Max"),
  Value      = c(mean(pdiff), sd(pdiff), median(pdiff), IQR(pdiff),
                 e1071::skewness(pdiff), e1071::kurtosis(pdiff), min(pdiff), max(pdiff))
)
```
:::


 \normalsize


 \scriptsize


::: {#tbl-summary-overhear .cell tbl-cap='Descriptive Statistics for Overhearing Condition' tbl-align='center'}

```{.r .cell-code}
summary_overhear |> knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}


|Statistics      | Value|
|:---------------|-----:|
|Mean            |  0.84|
|SD              |  0.18|
|Median          |  0.83|
|IQR             |  0.23|
|Skewness        | -1.04|
|Excess_Kurtosis |  0.22|
|Min             |  0.42|
|Max             |  1.00|


:::
:::


 \normalsize


 \scriptsize


::: {.cell layout-align="center" scale='80%'}

```{.r .cell-code}
# In a histogram, the range of data is split into consecutive, equal-width intervals. These are called bindwidth. Then it places each observation into a bindwidth.

ggplot(data.frame(overhear), aes(x = overhear)) +          
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),              
                  breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1),               
                  color = "gray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_bw() +                                              
  labs(x = "Proportion of Correct Retrieval of New Toys Out of 12 Trials",                                       
       y = "Density") 
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Results for Overhearing Condition](HW1_files/figure-pdf/fig-overhear-1.pdf){#fig-overhear fig-align='center' fig-pos='H'}
